title: 09 / Membrane
sub: A shaman strikes a great drum three times, each harder than the last, and then once more. Time all but stops as the beater lands: the ripple crawls out from the struck point and the hide turns to glass behind it, onto a realm of serpents and flowers inside the drum, while our universe's membrane ripples and tears open all round. A seamless 22-second loop in WebGPU, the drum's sound simulated from its own physics.

title: 04 / Gyre
sub: Forty glazed hoops, each one flipping over twice a loop, starting from the outside. A seamless 16-second loop, sphere-traced in WebGPU.
